Name: Farm Computer Blinking Alerts
Author: gulewei
Description:
[b]Never miss a harvest, finished machine, or empty silo again! [/b]

Your Farm Computer now pulses with a glowing blue aura whenever there's something on your farm that needs your attention. simple, visual, and perfectly integrated.

[list]
[*][b]Crops ready?[/b] → Glow[/*]
[*][b]Machines done?[/b] → Glow[/*]
[*][b]Hay empty?[/b] → Glow[/*]
[/list]Works automatically every morning. No configuration needed. Just place your Farm Computer anywhere on the farm and let it do the watching for you.

 *Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI.*
 *Cask detection only alerts when products reach iridium quality (quality >= 4)*

And you can find the source code [url=https://github.com/gulewei/FarmComputerBlinkingAlerts]here[/url].
